label: funded

county.title: CHAIN's horse county with 8 heads (1g's HORSE county at N 8)
county.basis: Assumed("funded 2026-09-29: 1g's HORSE county (unit-1g.md §3.3) at N 8, O41")

chain.note: Per unit made, at 52 ticks a year, as 1g's HORSE golden. Land coefficients are per tick of land service; the cost shock b x f multiplies every land coefficient (fodder's farmland and the head's pasture), as HORSES-SPEC §1.1's HORSE-A land factor.
chain.good_and_space: Appendix B's line: tasks on [0, x*) in horse-days (J(x) = 0.2x + 0.4x^2 a basket), the rest in labour; a basket is 1 good and h space

instances.role: rule B, the loop: P2.2b's instance
instances.what: fodder raised with horse-days; the horse a stock worn at delta, bred by a maker (M2) from fodder, labour and pasture, held and hired out wet by a capacity desk (M3)
instances.oracle: ChainEconomy (1g) on the chain above, J 1 (and J 2 for M3's hours: every price and quantity bit for bit the same at rho 0)

instances.role: the like-for-like flow control: the stocks layer off
instances.what: two flow types on the loop (the FH shape): fodder, and the horse-day made from fodder, labour and land with the head's wear folded in at delta/kappa heads a horse-day

m1_form.what: the same economy on M1's delta = 1 path: a one-tick head built from delta_tick times a head's recipe

instances.oracle: MachineEconomy (1c) in operating form, two flow types; equal to B within 9.3e-16 relative at every target and delta (the delta = 1 chain form bit for bit at every one)

instances.what: fodder from farmland and labour alone; the horse as in B

tape_params.note: Proposed keys for P2.2b's tape builder, named as P2.2a's (HORSES-SPEC §2.10, setup.rs); the two new ones carry rule B's goods inputs: fodder's horse-days (an input of the fodder desk's recipe, good 'traction') and a head's fodder (an input of the maker's build). Every value is per unit made and does not depend on the tick length, but N, T and kappa, which are per year, and delta, a fraction per year (Clock converts them).
B: Assumed("CHAIN.md §1.3-1.4 via unit-1g.md §3.3; funded 2026-09-29") (new key: horse-days a ton)
Assumed("CHAIN.md §1.3-1.4 via unit-1g.md §3.3; funded 2026-09-29") (new key: fodder a head)
tape_params.B_flow: the horse-day made by a flow desk (P2.1's TypeDesk) from fodder 0.020266073400477775, labour 0.10666518350119444 and land 0.0009997775251791654 a horse-day (delta/kappa of a head's recipe folded in), fodder as in B; or, on M1's path, B's keys with inst.horse.delta at a whole tick and a head's build times delta_tick
tape_params.cost_shock: b x f multiplies inst.fodder.land and inst.horse.land together (dated or at genesis)

cost_targets.what: P2.2a's cost targets: every land coefficient x1.1, x0.9 (Tier 2), x2, x0.5 (Tier 3); the battery's price, stock and coin displacements keep the base point as their target

funding_rule: provider baskets = (T + interest)/P_s - N > 0 (interest 0 at rho 0); coverage = T/(N P_s)

displacements_at_base.what: the provider's transfer due N(p' + h r') against its rent T r', and z/chi_max = ln(1 + v'/P_s')/chi_max, at the genesis of each battery price displacement that moves them, from B's base point at delta 8%
